description.value: Uno Beef Noodle is a Taiwanese restaurant in Richmond's main commercial strip on Number 3 Road, specializing in authentic beef noodle soup prepared with traditional techniques. The restaurant is popular enough to use a waitlist system and operates a second Richmond location on No. 2 Road. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a sit-down meal of Taiwanese noodle soups, dry noodles, bento rice combos, and appetizers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM name and address (2811 Number 3 Rd #135 Richmond, BC) and shows an active menu with Taiwanese noodle dishes, confirming the business is open. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags, so all such fields are null. The OSM record has no phone number and the website provides only a contact form, so phone is unverifiable.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website; contact available only via a web form.
Business has two Richmond locations (Number 3 Rd and No. 2 Rd); this OSM record covers only the Number 3 Rd location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Taiwanese restaurant confirmed by active website with current menu. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal in Richmond.
